segments.sentence: Good morning everyone, thank you for joining this fictional project review.
Today we will discuss the transcription prototype, the current schedule, and the next demonstration.
Elena is taking notes, and Marco will describe the latest changes to the service.
We have a working upload page, and the application can process a short recording locally.
The team tested both wave and MP3 files, using only synthetic and authorized material.
The browser displays a draft transcript with timestamps, and a reviewer can correct the wording.
It is important to say that an automatic transcript is not a verified meeting record.
No, we will not release the feature before the test results have been reviewed.
A quiet word can change the meaning of a decision, especially when it is a negation.
The review group will compare the draft with the audio instead of relying on confidence alone.
On fourteen April, the team plans to show a short demonstration to the product group.
The demonstration will use a fictional conversation and will not include a real customer recording.
The estimated preparation budget is two thousand four hundred euros for the first review.
That amount includes testing time, documentation, and a small reserve for unexpected work.
Paolo asked whether the team should add speaker labels before validating the basic transcript.
The answer was no: speaker labels should wait until the transcription workflow is reliable.
segments.review_note: The user reports the synthesizer may say the word 'colon' after 'no'; verify against the audio when scoring the reference.

segments.sentence: For the next checkpoint, Anna will check the behavior of upload, cancellation, and draft download.
She will record any mistake with its original timestamp and a short description of the correction.
The team will also inspect words spoken immediately after a pause of several seconds.
The first version accepts one recording at a time, rather than running several models together.
If another request arrives while a job is active, the application should explain that it is busy.
If a request is cancelled, the worker must stop before a new recording begins processing.
Elena noted that temporary audio should be removed after processing, cancellation, or failure.
A downloaded draft remains on the reviewer's computer and is outside the application's deletion control.
The transcript should be clearly marked as a draft until a person checks the original recording.
A person may correct a name, a number, a missing word, or an incorrect date.
During a previous synthetic test, the phrase not approved was especially important to preserve.
The model must not silently translate an Italian recording when transcription is requested.
The group agreed to keep model selection separate from the rest of the application.
This design lets the team compare a different transcription model using the same recording.
A smaller model may be useful if a later workload exceeds the available graphics memory.
The current laptop has limited resources, so each heavy processing stage should run in sequence.
Marco will measure memory during a longer recording and report the highest observed value.
These measurements will be collected with normal desktop applications running in the background.
A single successful sample does not prove that the system is ready for every meeting.
The reviewers should include different speaking speeds, pauses, and deliberately quiet words.
They should also check names, spoken dates, numbers, and amounts in both supported languages.
The next internal review is planned for twenty seven May, after the test notes are complete.
The target is fifteen reviewed recordings, although the exact quality threshold has not been chosen.
A threshold should be set after measuring a representative baseline rather than guessing in advance.
The team will document which recordings were used and whether each one was authorized.
Any real company recording requires separate approval before it is used for development.
For this demonstration, the audio and all names are artificial, and the numbers are fictional.
Before closing, Elena will summarize the actions and confirm who is responsible for each one.
Anna will review the browser workflow, and Marco will check graphics memory after cancellation.
Paolo will prepare the comparison notes, but he will not publish an unreviewed transcript.
No deadline will be changed without an explicit decision recorded in the meeting notes.
Thank you everyone; the team will meet again after the results have been reviewed.
